subject.title: feat(media): backfill, CDN-expiry retry, and once-mode drain fix

question: Should wacli continue reviewing this branch as one combined backfill/retry/migration PR after the one-shot drain work is split to https://github.com/openclaw/wacli/pull/295, or should the remaining media surface be split further?
rationale: The retry identity and changelog issues are mechanical, but the new commands, persistent unavailable-media state, and final PR shape need maintainer product acceptance.

options.title: Review remaining media surface after repair
options.body: Fix retry identity, remove the drain and changelog churn from this branch, then review backfill plus retry plus migration together.

options.title: Ask for smaller PRs
options.body: Split backfill, retry, and migration semantics into separate PRs while keeping the live proof attached to each relevant change.

options.title: Defer media retry
options.body: Keep only the lower-risk backfill work in this branch and revisit phone re-upload recovery as a separate product/API decision.

recommendation.title: Review remaining media surface after repair
recommendation.body: Fix retry identity, remove the drain and changelog churn from this branch, then review backfill plus retry plus migration together.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the current maintainer direction on splitting the drain fix and have the strongest history across the touched sync/media/store areas.
